> 第334章 副宫主（第1页）
苏白尘成为副宫主的事情让那太乙十二仙都有些接受不了。
而那排行第三的赤轮道人更是第一个站出来反对。
眼见老三开团，老四雪纹元君立马跟上，而后则是老八金峦元君，最后老二云虬子也终于开了金口表示质疑。
而在这一片反对声中，人族的三位太乙仙境丹曦子、明净真君以及沉钧子也分别表达了反对
“若是这问题出在后宫里，事情是不是太可怕了一点？”澜沧洙口中幽幽的说道。
果真是不比不知道，原来水青平时对他并没有自己想得那么情淡。只不过，云深不知处。
“刘晨，你这个家伙没有听见我给你说话吗？”安宁在我们身后大喊着。
虽然白燕没有跟陈宇说这事，但她跟慕容雪说了，因为这公司的前身是慕容雪的。尽管慕容雪以前不思进取，但‘朝阳’是慕容雪心血，白燕也就把希望寄托在慕容雪身上。
手机震动时，水青刚用完电脑，看到是圆心的号码，接起来，就听她问自己在哪儿。
辛想想怔怔地看着他，眼中充满好奇，皓洁的贝齿轻轻滑过自己的下唇，似乎很是期待他的带入。她也知道，自己这根本不是在接吻，而是胡搅蛮缠。
想到以前，她曾露过口风，和他一样，都有过哀莫大于心死的经历。他当时问过，却被她敷衍过去了。现在想想，那段经历恐怕是真的存在，甚至影响她至今，都没办法正常谈情说爱。
面对着两大强力玩家的攻击，南宫雪即使操作再好也仍然被匕首的毒击粘上，减低了50%速度的战士，操作明显差了不少的她在两个高攻职业面前立刻变成待宰的羔羊。
“哪里哪里，恐怕和你比还差了点，要知道以前我可是比你的境界高的，现在你都超过我了，好了不聊了，这里灵气浓郁，我要赶紧去修炼了了。”欧阳轻风背着屠戮刀往一边走去。
子时的梆声刚刚敲响，君绮萝便和龙胤翻身起来，换上夜行衣，直接跳窗出了屋子，然后避开守卫，轻车熟路的到了一座富丽堂皇的殿宇的屋顶。
张宁加重了“孤儿院”三个字的语气，目的是想告诉周梦云，在那种地方认识的人都是富有爱心的，想让周梦云放心，走停交的这个朋友虽然身世复杂但是人品绝对靠谱。
“那是自然！我是要成为时空魔神的人，我怎么可能进入战神之路？”中年男子傲然的说道。
“为什么？”展白一愣，两人之间有着死仇，不死不休，如果徐逸然说的都是真的，那么胡栖雁有着足够怨恨他的理由。
不管那设计图纸有什么猫腻，事情还没有弄清楚，她也不会凭借自己的揣测胡乱怀疑人。

因此，萧琅收到的回信上，写的就是月海国皇帝同意了见面，地点时间都由萧琅定，但条件是萧琅必须将月菁菁带去见他。
其实当时他那个朋友的言外之意就是他家儿子可能撞邪了，但是刘元京一听没撞到人，一个高兴过了头没意会到这层意思，就说改天请吃饭，就匆匆挂了电话。
在那之后不久，她突然联系我，跟我讲了一件发生在她身上的奇异事件。
如果这人只是一个普通的人，倒还罢了，可是这人居然是东海徐家那样变态的家族出来的。
她得到的关于萧琅的消息，都是通过萧弃那边带来的战场上的消息。

> Chapter 334 Deputy Palace Master (Page 1)
The Taiyi Twelve Immortals couldn't accept the fact that Su Baichen became the deputy palace master.
And Taoist Chi Lun, who ranked third, was the first to stand up and object.
Seeing the third child starting a group, the fourth child Xuewen Yuanjun immediately followed, followed by the eighth child Jinluan Yuanjun, and finally the second child Yun Qiuzi finally opened his mouth to express doubts.
In the midst of this opposition, the three Taiyi Immortal Realm Dan Xizi, Mingjing Zhenjun and Shen Junzi from the human race also expressed their opposition respectively.
"If this problem arises in the harem, wouldn't things be a little too scary?" Lan Cangzhu said quietly.
As expected, it turned out that Shui Qing was not as indifferent to him as he thought. It's just that Yun Shen doesn't know where he is.
"Liu Chen, didn't you hear what I was saying to you?" An Ning shouted behind us.
Although Bai Yan didn't tell Chen Yu about this, she told Murong Xue because the predecessor of this company was Murong Xue's. Although Murong Xue was not enterprising before, "Chaoyang" was Murong Xue's hard work, and Bai Yan placed her hopes on Murong Xue.
When the phone vibrated, Shui Qing had just finished using the computer and saw that it was Yuan Xin's number. When he picked up the phone, he heard her ask where he was.
Xin Xiangxiang looked at him blankly, her eyes full of curiosity, and her bright teeth gently slid across her lower lip, as if she was looking forward to his introduction. She also knew that she was not kissing at all, but messing around.
Thinking of the fact that she had revealed it before, just like him, she had experienced grief that was greater than heartbreak. He asked at the time, but she ignored him. Thinking about it now, that experience may have been real, and it has even affected her to this day, making it impossible for her to fall in love normally.
Facing the attacks of two powerful players, Nangong Xue was still stuck by the dagger's poisonous attack no matter how good her skills were. She was a warrior whose speed was reduced by 50%. Her skills were obviously much worse and she immediately became a lamb to be slaughtered in front of the two high-attack professions.
"No, I'm afraid I'm a little worse than you. You know, I used to be at a higher level than you, but now you have surpassed me. Let's stop talking. The aura here is rich, and I have to go practice quickly." Ouyang Qingfeng walked aside with the killing knife on his back.
As soon as the bang of midnight sounded, Jun Qiluo and Long Yin stood up, put on their night clothes, jumped out of the window and walked out of the house. Then they avoided the guards and reached the roof of a magnificent palace with ease.
Zhang Ning emphasized the word "orphanage" in order to tell Zhou Mengyun that the people he met in that kind of place were caring. He also wanted to reassure Zhou Mengyun that although the friend he had made during the trip had a complicated background, his character was absolutely reliable.
"That's natural! I want to become the Demon God of Time and Space. How can I enter the path of the God of War?" the middle-aged man said proudly.
"Why?" Zhan Bai was stunned. There was a deadly feud between the two. If what Xu Yiran said was true, then Hu Qiyan had enough reasons to resent him.
Regardless of what's fishy about the design drawings, she won't rely on her own speculations to cast doubt on people before the matter is clarified.
Therefore, the reply Xiao Lang received stated that the Emperor of Yuehai Kingdom agreed to meet, and the location and time were determined by Xiao Lang, but the condition was that Xiao Lang must bring Yue Jingjing to see him.
In fact, the implication of his friend at the time was that his son might have bumped into something evil, but when Liu Yuanjing heard that he had bumped into no one, he was too happy to realize this meaning, so he said that he would invite him to dinner another day and hurriedly hung up the phone.
Not long after that, she contacted me out of the blue and told me about a strange incident that had happened to her.
If this person was just an ordinary person, it would be fine, but this person turned out to beHe comes from a perverted family like the Xu family of Donghai.
The news she got about Xiao Lang was all from the battlefield brought by Xiao Qi.
